In a yellow ellipse. Horizontal black line in a rose/pink panel, no end dots, no arrows. A row of 3 pictures of a square, rounded, golden-brown paratha (photo-like). Expression: 1/3 + 1/3 + 1/3 + 1/3 = 4/3 = 1 + 1/3 = 1 1/3. Light-blue panel. Horizontal black line with a filled black dot at both ends; long, runs far to the right of the marked part.
